thread:
Emily: Quick proposal — run a 45m webinar on practical inference pipelines: focus on benchmark narratives, two short customer case studies, and a live demo fallback. Who's in for speaking?
Sanjay: Love it. Suggested split: 15m benchmarks, 15m customer stories, 10m demo, 5m Q&A. I can cover the benchmark narrative.
Aisha: I can do the fintech case study (we have nice before/after latency numbers). Need support to pull production traces.
Tom: I can own the demo ops/run-order. Prefer recorded demo with a live cutover if infra is stable. Fallback = recorded + video clip. :white_check_mark:
Emily: @Zoe would you moderate? We want tight timeboxing and 2 audience prompts for Q&A.
Zoe: Yes — I’ll moderate. Request: collect 3 pre-submitted Qs and surface them first 10m, then live Qs.
Raj: Slide designer here — I’ll assemble master deck. Please send 2–3 highlight bullets + headshots + 1-sentence bio by Wed EOD.
Kelly: Rehearsal ops proposal: schedule 2 dry runs — tech check (30m) 3 days before, full run (60m) 1 day before. Target timezone: 9am PT. I’ll send invites once we confirm speakers.
rehearsal-bot: Reminder created: tech-check dry run on 2025-01-07T16:00:00Z, full rehearsal on 2025-01-09T16:00:00Z.
Sanjay: Quick benchmark note: keep the narrative simple — workload definition, config choices (batching/quant), and 2 slides on cost/latency tradeoffs with a one-line takeaway per slide. I’ll drop a draft in Marketing Drive: https://drive.redwood/example-bench-draft
Emily: I’ll own the registration page + launch post copy. CTA = sign up for eval credits + request a benchmark walkthrough. Draft by Thu morning.
Zoe: Q: who will field audience technical Qs live — Aisha or Tom?
Aisha: I’ll handle deep technical questions about model behavior and metrics. Zoe you handle product/pricing/threading.
Tom: Ops reminder — allocate a dedicated demo instance to avoid noisy neighbor effects. Tagging eng-infra for capacity check.
Emily: Action list summary: Emily copy/registration, Sanjay benchmark slides, Aisha case study + Qs, Tom demo infra + run-order, Raj deck, Zoe moderation. Confirm speaker list and rehearsal times by Tue so Kelly can finalize invites. :spiral_calendar:
